```{ojs}
import { rangeInput as rangeInput } from '@mootari/range-slider'
import {slider as sliderInput} from "@jashkenas/inputs"
```

```{ojs}
rawData =  FileAttachment("data/rfl_lowpass_shaped_v2.csv").csv({typed: true});
```

::: {.g-col-12 .samples-filter}
```{ojs}
categoryLookup = new Map([
  ["Hectorite", {category: "Minerals", color: "#4daf4a"}],  
  ["Magnesite", {category: "Minerals", color: "#e377c2"}], 
  ["Saponite", {category: "Minerals", color: "#a65628"}], 
  ["Sepiolite", {category: "Minerals", color: "#ff7f00"}], 
  ["Vermiculite", {category: "Minerals", color: "#7f7f7f"}],  

  ["Oak leaf, new growth", {category: "Vegetation", color: "#3a8040"}],  
  ["Oak leaf, one year old", {category: "Vegetation", color: "#bfcc76"}],
  ["Oak leaf, scenesced", {category: "Vegetation", color: "#ed8e64"}],
  ["Maple Leaf", {category: "Vegetation", color: "#7aa6d5"}]
]);

samples = d3.sort(d3.group(rawData, d => d.sample).keys());
categorizedData = rawData.map(d => {
  const info = categoryLookup.get(d.sample);
  return {
    ...d,
    category: info ? info.category : undefined,
    color: info ? info.color : undefined
  };
}).filter(d => d.category !== undefined);
categories = Array.from(new Set(categorizedData.map(d => d.category)));

viewof categorySel = Inputs.select(categories, {
  label: " ",
  value: "Minerals"
});
sampleOptions = Array.from(categoryLookup.keys()).filter(
  s => samples.includes(s) && categorySel.includes(categoryLookup.get(s).category)
);
```

```{ojs}
sampleSel = sampleOptions;
```
:::

```{ojs}
fmt = d3.format(".1f");
viewof slider = rangeInput({
  min: d3.extent(rawData, d => d.wavelength)[0],
  max: d3.extent(rawData, d => d.wavelength)[1],
  step: 0.7
})
minWL = slider[0];
maxWL = slider[1];
xMin = d3.min(rawData, d => d.wavelength);
xMax = d3.max(rawData, d => d.wavelength);
normalize = true
```

```{ojs}
//viewof resolutionSel = Inputs.range([7, 154], {step: 1, value: 7, label: "Resolution (nm) x10"}); 
viewof resolutionSel = Inputs.range([0.7, 15.4], {step: 0.7, value: 0.7, label: ""})
```

```{ojs}
//viewof windowSel = Inputs.range([1, 15], {step: 1, value: 1, label: "Spectral Averaging Window"})
windowSel = 1
```


```{ojs}
filteredData = categorizedData.filter(
  d => d.wavelength >= minWL && 
  d.wavelength <= maxWL && 
  categorySel.includes(d.category) &&
  sampleSel.includes(d.sample)
);
```

```{ojs}
plotWidth = Math.min(width, 1800);
uiPx = Math.max(14, Math.round(plotWidth / 55));

html`<style>
```

```{ojs}
{
  if (filteredData.length < 1) {
    return html`<div style="color:#ffffff;">No active selections to plot.</div>`;
  }

  const rowsBySample = d3.group(filteredData, d => d.sample);  // Map<sample, rows[]>
  const adjustedData = [];
  //const resolutionSize = resolutionSel;
  const resolutionSize = Math.max(1, Math.round(resolutionSel / 0.7)); 

  for (const [sample, rows] of rowsBySample) {
    let adjusted = rows.map(r => r.reflectance);

    if (windowSel > 1){
      adjusted = d3.blur(adjusted, windowSel);
    } 

    let ymin, ymax, denom;
    if (normalize) {
      ymin = d3.min(adjusted);
      ymax = d3.max(adjusted);
      denom = ymax - ymin; 
    }

    for (let i = 0; i < adjusted.length; i += resolutionSize) {
      let y = adjusted[i];
      if (normalize){
        y = denom > 0 ? (adjusted[i] - ymin) / denom : 0 //avoid divide by 0
      }
      
      adjustedData.push({
        wavelength: rows[i].wavelength,
        reflectance: y,
        sample
      });
    }
  }

  const activeSamples = Array.from(new Set(filteredData.map(d => d.sample)));
  const fontPx = Math.max(10, Math.round(plotWidth / 55));
  const rotate = plotWidth < 650 ? -45 : 0;

  const xTickStart = Math.ceil(minWL / 20) * 20;
  const xTickEnd = Math.floor(maxWL / 20) * 20;

  const yLabel = normalize ? "Normalized Reflectance" : "Reflectance";
  const xLabel = "Wavelength (nm)"

  const yStep = 0.05;
  const maxY = normalize ? 1 : d3.max(adjustedData, d => d.reflectance);
  const yMaxTick = normalize ? 1 : Math.ceil(maxY/yStep) * yStep;

  const fmtVal = normalize ? d3.format(".3f") : d3.format(".4f");

  const p = Plot.plot({
    // width: plotWidth,
    width: 1800,
    height: 650,
    // height: Math.round(plotWidth * (11/20)),
    marginRight: 100,
    marginLeft: 75,   
    marginTop: 45,   
    marginBottom: 40,

    x: {
      // label: xLabel, // Remove label from axis config
      label: " ",
      tickPadding: 10,
      tickRotate: rotate,
      domain: [minWL, maxWL],                                         
      ticks: d3.range(xTickStart, xTickEnd + 1, 30),
      tickFormat: d3.format("d"),
      labelArrow: "none"
    },
    y: {
      // label: yLabel, // Remove label from axis config
      label: " ",
      grid: true,
      tickFormat: d => d.toFixed(2),
      ticks: 10,
      nice: false,
      tickPadding: 0,
      domain: [0, maxY + 0.02],
      labelArrow: "none"
    },
    color: {
      legend: true,
      domain: activeSamples,
      range: activeSamples.map(s => categoryLookup.get(s).color)

    },
    style: { 
      fontSize: `${fontPx}px`, 
      "--plot-font-size": `${fontPx}px`,
      backgroundColor: "#000000",
      color: "#ffffff"
    },

    marks: [
      Plot.line(adjustedData, {
        x: "wavelength",
        y: "reflectance",
        stroke: "sample",
        title: "sample",
        strokeWidth: 5
      }),




      // Plot.dot(adjustedData, Plot.pointerX({
      //   x: "wavelength",
      //   y: "reflectance",
      //   fill: "sample",
      //   stroke: "white",
      //   marker: "circle",
      //   strokeWidth: 3,
      //   r: 5
      // })),
      // Plot.text(adjustedData, Plot.pointerX({
      //   px: "wavelength",
      //   py: "reflectance",
      //   dx: width * 0.5,
      //   dy: -20,
      //   frameAnchor: "top-left",
      //   fontVariant: "tabular-nums",
      //   fontSize: fontPx * 0.8,
      //   text: d => `${d.sample}   λ ${fmt(d.wavelength)} nm    ${fmtVal(d.reflectance)}`
      // })),
  // Removed Plot.text(adjustedData, Plot.selectLast(...)) to eliminate right-side label
    ]
  });
  const swatches = p.querySelector('div[class*="-swatches-wrap"], div[class*="-swatches"], .plot-swatches');
  let legendHTML = "";
  if (swatches) {
    swatches.style.fontSize = `${fontPx * 0.8}px`;
    legendHTML = swatches.outerHTML;
    swatches.remove(); // Remove legend from plot container
  }
  return html`
    <div class="spectra-plot-legend-container" style="display: flex; flex-direction: row; align-items: center; justify-content: center;">
      <div style="writing-mode: vertical-rl; transform: rotate(180deg); font-size:${fontPx * 1.1}px; margin-right: 1em;">${yLabel}</div>
      <div>${p}</div>
      <div>${legendHTML}</div>
    </div>
    <div style="text-align:center; font-size:${fontPx * 1.1}px; margin-top: 0.25em;">${xLabel}</div>
    <div style="display: flex; gap: 2rem; align-items: center; justify-content: center; margin-top: 1rem;">
      <div style="font-size:1.5em;">Spectral Range: ${viewof slider}</div>
      <div style="font-size: 1.5em;">Spectral Sampling Interval (nm): ${viewof resolutionSel}</div>
    </div>`;
}
```
